description: TASK-33: VirtualPyTest plays 2048 on a web host and an Android phone; score, max tile and speed per run (script game/game_2048).

panels.description: Every game_2048 run that recorded a score, quick checks included.
panels.title: Runs

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM script_results /*device-scope*/ WHERE ('*' = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR host_name || ':' || device_name = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')))) sr WHERE sr.script_name = 'game_2048' AND sr.metadata ? 'final_score' AND $__timeFilter(sr.started_at) AND sr.metadata->>'path' IN (${path:sqlstring}) AND sr.metadata->>'player' IN (${player:sqlstring})

panels.description: Runs that played until no move was left (stop reason game_over, or game_over_not_confirmed when the end screen was not recognised).
panels.title: Full games

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM script_results /*device-scope*/ WHERE ('*' = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR host_name || ':' || device_name = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')))) sr WHERE sr.script_name = 'game_2048' AND sr.metadata ? 'final_score' AND $__timeFilter(sr.started_at) AND sr.metadata->>'path' IN (${path:sqlstring}) AND sr.metadata->>'player' IN (${player:sqlstring}) AND sr.metadata->>'stop_reason' IN ('game_over', 'game_over_not_confirmed')

SELECT 100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN sr.success THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM (SELECT * FROM script_results /*device-scope*/ WHERE ('*' = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR host_name || ':' || device_name = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')))) sr WHERE sr.script_name = 'game_2048' AND sr.metadata ? 'final_score' AND $__timeFilter(sr.started_at) AND sr.metadata->>'path' IN (${path:sqlstring}) AND sr.metadata->>'player' IN (${player:sqlstring})

panels.description: Best score of a full game.
panels.title: Best score

targets.rawSql: SELECT max((sr.metadata->>'final_score')::int) FROM (SELECT * FROM script_results /*device-scope*/ WHERE ('*' = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR host_name || ':' || device_name = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')))) sr WHERE sr.script_name = 'game_2048' AND sr.metadata ? 'final_score' AND $__timeFilter(sr.started_at) AND sr.metadata->>'path' IN (${path:sqlstring}) AND sr.metadata->>'player' IN (${player:sqlstring}) AND sr.metadata->>'stop_reason' IN ('game_over', 'game_over_not_confirmed')

panels.description: Highest tile reached in a full game.
panels.title: Best tile

targets.rawSql: SELECT max((sr.metadata->>'max_tile')::int) FROM (SELECT * FROM script_results /*device-scope*/ WHERE ('*' = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR host_name || ':' || device_name = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')))) sr WHERE sr.script_name = 'game_2048' AND sr.metadata ? 'final_score' AND $__timeFilter(sr.started_at) AND sr.metadata->>'path' IN (${path:sqlstring}) AND sr.metadata->>'player' IN (${player:sqlstring}) AND sr.metadata->>'stop_reason' IN ('game_over', 'game_over_not_confirmed')

SELECT sum(COALESCE((sr.metadata->>'tokens_in')::int,0) + COALESCE((sr.metadata->>'tokens_out')::int,0)) FROM (SELECT * FROM script_results /*device-scope*/ WHERE ('*' = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR host_name || ':' || device_name = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')))) sr WHERE sr.script_name = 'game_2048' AND sr.metadata ? 'final_score' AND $__timeFilter(sr.started_at) AND sr.metadata->>'path' IN (${path:sqlstring}) AND sr.metadata->>'player' IN (${player:sqlstring})

panels.description: One point per game played to the end, split by platform (path) and player.
panels.title: Final score per full game

targets.rawSql: SELECT sr.started_at AS time, (sr.metadata->>'path') || ' / ' || (sr.metadata->>'player') AS metric, (sr.metadata->>'final_score')::int AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM script_results /*device-scope*/ WHERE ('*' = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR host_name || ':' || device_name = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')))) sr WHERE sr.script_name = 'game_2048' AND sr.metadata ? 'final_score' AND $__timeFilter(sr.started_at) AND sr.metadata->>'path' IN (${path:sqlstring}) AND sr.metadata->>'player' IN (${player:sqlstring}) AND sr.metadata->>'stop_reason' IN ('game_over', 'game_over_not_confirmed') ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Average time from a move to a settled board read from the captured pixels (plus the LLM decision for llm runs). Phase-1 web runs, which read the DOM, are left out.
panels.title: Seconds per move

targets.rawSql: SELECT sr.started_at AS time, sr.metadata->>'path' AS metric, (sr.metadata->>'avg_move_ms')::numeric / 1000 AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM script_results /*device-scope*/ WHERE ('*' = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR host_name || ':' || device_name = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')))) sr WHERE sr.script_name = 'game_2048' AND sr.metadata ? 'final_score' AND $__timeFilter(sr.started_at) AND sr.metadata->>'path' IN (${path:sqlstring}) AND sr.metadata->>'player' IN (${player:sqlstring}) AND sr.metadata ? 'userinterface' ORDER BY 1

SELECT sr.started_at AS "Started", sr.host_name AS "Host", sr.device_name AS "Device", sr.metadata->>'path' AS "Platform", sr.metadata->>'player' AS "Player", (sr.metadata->>'final_score')::int AS "Score", (sr.metadata->>'max_tile')::int AS "Max tile", (sr.metadata->>'move_count')::int AS "Moves", (sr.metadata->>'board_resyncs')::int AS "Resyncs", sr.metadata->>'stop_reason' AS "Stop reason", CASE WHEN sr.success THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END AS "Result", COALESCE('report', '') AS "Report" FROM (SELECT * FROM script_results /*device-scope*/ WHERE ('*' = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')) OR host_name || ':' || device_name = ANY(string_to_array(${allowed_devices:sqlstring}, '|')))) sr WHERE sr.script_name = 'game_2048' AND sr.metadata ? 'final_score' AND $__timeFilter(sr.started_at) AND sr.metadata->>'path' IN (${path:sqlstring}) AND sr.metadata->>'player' IN (${player:sqlstring}) ORDER BY sr.started_at DESC LIMIT 100
